name: Stabilize the prototype
goal: Make the current app run reliably and put a verification harness in place.

tasks.title: Add validated environment configuration and setup docs
acceptance: .env.example documents EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL and optional feature flags without real secrets
src/lib/env.ts validates required public env vars at startup and exports a typed env object
docs/SETUP.md explains install, env, run, and test commands
No real API key is committed

tasks.title: Add a deterministic test harness
acceptance: Jest with jest-expo is configured and can run TypeScript tests
npm test runs the suite non-interactively
A smoke test proves the harness works
The test script is not weakened or replaced with a no-op

tasks.title: Fix the voice loop end to end
acceptance: Starting and stopping the microphone always releases the recorder in a finally block
A final transcript is produced and sent to the chat, or the UI clearly falls back to text
Permission denied, no-speech, aborted, and network errors reset listening state
TTS cancellation resets isTalking
At least three unit tests cover start, stop, and error paths

tasks.title: Remove dead code and stale configuration
acceptance: The unused localhost webhook component is deleted
The stale (tabs) anchor is removed or replaced with a real route
No unused starter-template components remain imported
Typecheck and lint still pass

tasks.title: Harden the AI service: timeout, retry, and TTS lifecycle
acceptance: AI requests have an explicit timeout and a clear typed error
Transient failures are retried with a bounded backoff
TTS onDone and onError both reset isTalking
Unit tests cover success, timeout, and failure
No real network call is made in tests

tasks.title: Align the app identity with CAREMATE
acceptance: Expo name is CAREMATE and slug is caremate
Package name is caremate
README no longer describes a generic create-expo-app starter
No AIDME branding remains in user-facing config

tasks.title: Add CI for typecheck, lint, and tests
acceptance: CI runs on push and pull request
CI installs with npm ci and runs typecheck, lint, and tests
CI has no continue-on-error
Workflow permissions are least-privilege

tasks.title: Fix accessibility and contrast quick wins
acceptance: Body text meets 4.5:1 contrast on its background
Icon-only controls have accessibility labels
Touch targets are at least 44x44
New chat messages are announced to screen readers

tasks.title: Phase 0 review
acceptance: A human has run the app and confirmed the mic and chat work on a device or simulator
A human has reviewed the Phase 0 diff and test quality
The Gemini key has been rotated and removed from the client
The reviewer signs off in loop/ESCALATIONS.md
